title: Janice STFU
headline: Lykke Li thought Drake's request was a joke. It wasn't.
caption:
It wasn't the first time Drake reached for Lykke Li's music. He sampled her "Little Bit" on his 2009 mixtape So Far Gone. So when Rick Nowels, who wrote "I Follow Rivers" with her and Björn Yttling, texted about the request to interpolate it, she says she first thought he was joking.

The song started life as "That's Just How I Feel," previewed on Drake's Iceman livestream in September 2025, then got reworked as "Janice STFU." Billboard reported the title nods to Janice Soprano, Tony's manipulative sister on The Sopranos. Producer Rogét Chahayed, a fan of the show, called it a "full-circle" moment.

The Guardian's Alexis Petridis called the interpolation lazy. The Fader's Steffanee Wang called it ingenious and named the track a song-of-the-summer pick. It debuted at No. 1 on the Hot 100, Drake's 14th, passing Michael Jackson for the most by a male solo artist. Li said it had "raw, revenge, hip-hop energy," and that it made her miss "Marvins Room" and "Hotline Bling."

Lazy borrow or ingenious hook? Pick one.
